task: Gate Knowledge Bases, Datasources and Code Indexing UI surfaces (nav, routes) behind three new backend-driven feature flags so they are fully absent from the UI when retrieval is unavailable.

key_reasoning.reason: Three distinct product concepts (Knowledge Bases, Datasources, Code Indexing) named by the ticket currently converge into one route family (data-sources) and one nav entry, differentiated only by index_type inside DataSourcesPage.tsx. Gating three independent backend flags onto this merged surface likely requires touching constants (featureFlags.ts), router.tsx (route-level gating), Navigation.tsx (nav-item gating), and DataSourcesPage.tsx itself (to hide/filter sub-surfaces by index_type when only some flags are enabled) — a new reconciliation pattern, not a drop-in repeat of the Cost Centers/Analytics precedent.

Core intent is clear (hide these three capabilities from every entry point), but technical-analysis surfaces an unresolved design question the spec/plan phase must answer: how do three independently-toggleable flags map onto one existing merged page/route/nav-item, whether the separate AWS Bedrock 'Knowledge Bases' page (VendorEntityType.knowledgebases) is in scope, and whether discoverability surfaces beyond nav/routes (global search, quick actions) named in AC29's corollary even exist in this app.

Closest existing pattern is FeatureGuard plus conditional nav-item construction (used for Cost Centers, Analytics, AI Adoption Config, Skills/Favorites) — a well-established mechanism for gating a whole, distinct surface. It does not cover reconciling three independent flags against one merged surface. AC29's corollary enumerates specific entry-point variants (nav, routes, deep links, search, quick actions) and none of the affected files (Navigation.tsx, DataSourcesPage.tsx, router.tsx's gating composition) have any existing test coverage, so this is a defensive-pattern gap per the guide's bump criterion.

Expected modified files: src/constants/featureFlags.ts, src/router.tsx, src/components/Navigation/Navigation.tsx, src/pages/dataSources/DataSourcesPage.tsx, possibly src/utils/indexing.ts and src/utils/settings.ts (credential-picker filtering). Expected new files: test coverage for Navigation.tsx, DataSourcesPage.tsx and router gating composition, none of which exist today. Spans 3+ directories (constants/, components/Navigation/, pages/dataSources/, plus their __tests__ subdirectories).

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L to XL: 'Affects multiple workflows' — the ticket gates three distinct product workflows (Knowledge Bases, Datasources, Code Indexing) that must each independently disappear, despite converging on shared route/nav/page surfaces today.

Technical Risk bumped from M to L: acceptance criteria (AC29 corollary) enumerate specific entry-point variants (nav, routes, deep links, search, quick actions) and no existing test template covers any of the affected surfaces (Navigation.tsx, DataSourcesPage.tsx, router.tsx gating composition) — a defensive-pattern coverage gap per the guide.
